projectDescription: An experimental 64-bit x86_64 kernel with GRUB/Multiboot boot support, a custom K64XFS filesystem, a registry-based driver/service runtime, interactive shell, usermode ELF execution, and a Linux compatibility layer (KLCS).
keyFeatures: GRUB/Multiboot-booted 64-bit x86_64 kernel with paged long-mode setup
Custom K64XFS filesystem with GRUB module support, block-backed persistence, journaling skeleton, and xfsctl tooling
Registry-based driver (.k64m) and service (.k64s) runtime with lifecycle management and async scheduling
Priority-aware cooperative scheduler with worker tasks, yield/sleep, and PIT-driven tick source
Ring-3 user-mode ELF execution with per-process page tables and int 0x80 syscall gate
Service-call ABI (syscall 25) bridging userland to native K64 service methods
KLCS – K64 Linux Compatibility Service for running static and dynamically-linked x86_64 Linux ELFs
Interactive shell backed by a managed async service with history, cursor editing, and PS/2 + serial input
Ethernet networking (RTL8139 / Intel e1000), ARP, DHCP, DNS, ICMP, UDP, TCP, and kcurl HTTP client
KPM package manager client consuming a plain HTTP package repository in .kpg binary format
POSIX-like multiuser permission model with hashed passwords, sudo, UID/GID ownership, and mode bits
ATA PIO block layer with MBR partition support and storagectl installer flow
publicApiSurface: k64_modules_register_driver() — register a driver in the .k64m registry
k64_system_register_service() — register a service in the .k64s registry
k64_system_register_command() — register a shell-visible service command
k64_system_register_call() — register a named service-call method
k64_system_dispatch_call() — invoke a service method by service+method name
Syscall 25: service_call(call_ptr) — userland-to-kernel service call gate
Shell built-in commands: help, clear, ps, sched, reboot, shutdown, layout, ticks, task, serial, echo, yield, panic
Service commands: servicectl, driverctl, storagectl, netctl, fsctl, userctl, kpm, elfrun, reload, sysfetch, uname, k64cc, klcs
.k64m binary artifact format (K64M magic, version, type, flags, priority, name, entry_path)
.k64s binary artifact format (K64S magic, version, class, flags, priority, poll_interval, name, entry_path)
Boot config keys: pit_hz, log_level, boot_mode (GRUB multiboot command line)
